purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Chalisgaon

queries.query: Chalisgaon Maharashtra official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bhulekh BhuNaksha Jalgaon
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh services, Mahabhumi/Mahabhunakasha, the Jalgaon district Chalisgaon Tahsil Office, and Jalgaon revenue links to Maharashtra land-record services. The current public Mahabhunakasha route was identified, but a bounded anonymous GET timed out before viewer configuration or parcel schema could be inspected.

queries.query: चाळीसगाव महाराष्ट्र अधिकृत भू नकाशा जमिनीचे अभिलेख भूमी अभिलेख
queries.result: Marathi first-party discovery identified Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh services describing ई-नकाशा/भू नकाशा as village, city-survey, and parcel maps with land records, and the Marathi Bhulekh/Mahabhumi routes. The official page states the department operates the service; no anonymous Chalisgaon parcel response or safe native parcel identity was obtained.

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Maharashtra, Bhumi Abhilekh Department / Settlement Commissioner and Director of Land Records; local Chalisgaon Tahsil and Jalgaon district revenue administration
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official Jalgaon district site identifies the Chalisgaon Tahsil Office and Chalisgaon revenue entries. Maharashtra's official Bhumi Abhilekh pages identify the state land-record and map services. This evidences local administrative custody and a state cadastral-map service, not open citywide parcel-vector coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh service catalog lists Bhulekh, e-Maps/Bhu Naksha, and related land-record services; the page is available in Marathi and identifies the land-record directorate as operator.
Official Mahabhumi dashboard identifies Mahabhunakasha (maps with land records) and state land-record services.
Official Jalgaon district administration page identifies the Chalisgaon Tahsil Office.
Official Jalgaon revenue page links Maharashtra 7/12 and old land-record services and lists multiple Chalisgaon taluka revenue records.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe native parcel identity plus unchanged full polygon was returned. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point miss or viewer timeout is treated as citywide absence.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 via first-party indexed page; current Marathi service catalog retrieved, including e-Maps/Bhu Naksha and links to Mahabhunakasha.
First-party dashboard identified from discovery as the Maharashtra land-record portal and linked Mahabhunakasha; no login or credentials used.
Bounded anonymous request timed out after 30 seconds; no viewer JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, parcel ID, or geometry response was obtained.
HTTP 200 first-party district administration page; Chalisgaon Tahsil Office document route retrieved.
HTTP 200 first-party district revenue page; Chalisgaon taluka entries and official Maharashtra land-record links observed.

uncertainty: The current Mahabhunakasha viewer was not reachable within the bounded anonymous request timeout, so its live JavaScript/configuration, service endpoint, schema, CRS, and native parcel identity semantics remain unverified.

The official sources support Maharashtra land-record and map-service custody and Chalisgaon Tahsil context, but do not by themselves prove that all Chalisgaon municipal land parcels are openly vectorized or retrievable.
